static_assessments.finding: Bennett uses (offset+1/[a*(T/1000)^b+c*(T/1000)^d])*scale, with b=-2.45,d=0.837. GL2022 uses alpha*exp(-gamma/T), gamma in K. Numeric constants are read from the frozen packet and each sample remains SOURCE_FORMULA_SAMPLE.

Only the exact 27 Bennett and 2 GL2022 printed temperatures can enter the fit path. All six variants and 77 original cells remain catalog obligations; no interpolation or fit-range extension is inferred. Bovino b-unit conflict prevents its evaluation.

Exact rational conversion rejects bool and binary float, malformed/nonfinite strings; positive temperature/native-node, finite-positive result and explicit extra-spin guards are present. Unknown providers reject, and every physical-rate request rejects.

TIQM/SQM simultaneous selection is rejected as alternative methods. Ortho/para simultaneous selection is conservatively rejected while their spin-sum convention remains unbound; this is not a claim that the two product branches are the same physical channel. A catalog may retain all six inactive variants. No source total is silently identified with a fully specified v/j population or inverse detailed balance.

With X=sum(x), pi nonnegative and sum(pi)=1, r=x-pi*X sums to zero. The module computes J=h*d^T*x, lift flux=h*(d^T*pi)*X and defect=h*d^T*r exactly. Subtracting c=(max(d)+min(d))/2 from d proves |defect|<=h*(max(d)-min(d))*||r||_1/2. Nonempty matched dimensions and nonnegative x,d,h are guarded.

For h>0 and all allowed nonnegative population vectors, the fixed-pi scalar closure is exact iff d is constant, as shown by basis-vector choices. The h=0 and x=pi*X cases are explicitly qualified; the returned uniform_scalar_closure flag concerns the full family, not only a zero-total sample. This is a conditional finite algebra statement, not physical state reconstruction or a strong no-go.

The declared distinct-reactant identity k*nA*nB/nref has units events per reference nucleus per proper second for cm-based inputs. It asserts neither a particular physical density/clock nor a consumer binding. All six source reactions have distinct incoming species; no identical-pair divisor is invented.

Source-formula implementation, table residuals, method alternatives, physical covariance and rate/Q admission are separate. Six new compiler columns and 29 fit diagnostics have a new bounded contract; old149 columns/249 checks/PHYS91 results and budgets are read-only reused.
